root_cause.text: phonet_device_destroy() frees a phonet_device immediately after list_del_rcu() without waiting for an RCU grace period, allowing concurrent RCU readers to access freed memory.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes `kfree(pnd)` to `kfree_rcu(pnd, rcu)` in `net/phonet/pn_dev.c`. The commit message explicitly states: "phonet_device_destroy() removes a phonet_device from the per-net device list with list_del_rcu(), but frees it immediately. RCU readers walking the same list can still hold a pointer to the object after it has been removed, leading to a slab-use-after-free."

intent_record.intent_summary: Use RCU-safe free to prevent use-after-free when destroying a phonet device structure.
intent_record.how: Defers deallocation of `pnd` until all RCU read-side critical sections have completed, preventing potential use-after-free.
